changelog:
alibabacloud-history-lock-diagnose v0.0.1 – Initial Release

- Diagnoses historical lock wait issues on PolarDB/RDS MySQL, identifying root cause, lock chain, and lock holder.
- Integrates with Aliyun CLI and DAS; requires Python ≥3.7 and Aliyun CLI ≥3.3.3.
- Supports various lock types: InnoDB row/metadata/table locks, deadlocks, and more.
- Includes strict parameter confirmation, observability (per-session user-agent), and RAM permission handling.
- Outputs concise, actionable diagnosis and recommendations based on real SQL audit data.
